scientific_integrity: Analytic algebraic reconstruction proof and exact lower-jet collision; bundled standalone symbolic checker. Full motivating preprint comparison limited to abstract. No claimed independent validation.
scientific_limitations: Uniqueness applies only to four strictly separated intervals of one common width, compared with the same class, using exact noiseless derivatives. No general noisy stability or other interval count is covered. The full motivating 2026 preprint was not accessible for inspection, leaving a bibliographic residual risk.
title: Sixth-order Fourier-intensity jets identify four equal-width intervals
